tips.text: Keep 575 Ducats and 200,000 credits banked from relic duplicates so you can buy it whenever Baro brings it.
Crack relics in a full squad of four and take the highest-Ducat reward; a full squad gets four reward picks.
Skip Aya for Ducats at Varzia; commenters call 5 Ducats per Aya a terrible rate.
Do not look for it in your Mastery or unmastered lists; it stays hidden until you own it.
Players call it a small upgrade over the Lenz with a big looks upgrade, so buy it for Mastery or collecting.
The 575 Ducats are a few relic sessions; the only real cost is waiting for Baro to carry it.
